title: CanonicalJob
description: Canonical job definition used across the platform for broker submissions, worker dispatch, and audit trails.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this job. Immutable after creation.

worker_id.description: Target worker or agent responsible for executing this job.

payload.description: Opaque job payload. Schema is validated by the worker's accepted payload contract.

read_scopes.description: Paths or logical scopes the worker may read.

write_scopes.description: Paths or logical scopes the worker may write. Must be a subset of read_scopes and assigned workspace.

correlation_id.description: Tracing identifier linking this job to a parent workflow or operator request.

timeout.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds before the broker may cancel the job.

priority.description: Queue priority. 'critical' may preempt lower-priority jobs.

issued_by.description: Agent or service that submitted this job.

tags.description: Optional classification tags for routing and filtering.
